task_description: Implement Python dynamic typing features using minivm's ref system. Enable operations (arithmetic, comparison, truthiness, str, len, iteration, indexing, unary, membership) on Any-typed and union-typed values via runtime type dispatch through host functions. When types become statically known through inference, narrowing, or specialization, use existing static paths for maximum performance.

verification.summary: go vet ./... passes, go test ./... passes (all 11 packages), 36+ TestCompileDynamic tests cover all dynamic operations with both happy and error paths. Semantic review approved on v3 after fixing 9 issues across 3 review iterations.
